tactics: intro α a motive a_1 t F

intro α a motive a_1 t F <;> exact (List.Mem.rec (motive := fun l t => motive l t ∧ List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t) (fun as => ⟨F _ _ (by constructor), by constructor⟩) (fun b h ih => ⟨F _ _ (by constructor <;> simp_all), by constructor <;> simp_all⟩) t).1

intro α a motive a_1 t F <;> have key : motive a_1 t ∧ List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t := by induction t with | head => exact ⟨F _ _ (by constructor), by constructor⟩ | tail b h ih => exact ⟨F _ _ (by constructor <;> simp_all), by constructor <;> simp_all⟩
intro α a motive a_1 t F <;> induction t <;> apply F <;> constructor <;> simp_all
